g.text: WHITE ROOM / IDT / GST REFUNDS
Unjust enrichment: six exceptions
No self-declaration / CA or CMA certificate for eligible cases
Ordinary cases: ≤ ₹2 lakh declaration; > ₹2 lakh certificate.
01 IGST paid on exports
Exports are zero-rated; refund removes domestic tax.
Remember: Export goods, not taxes.
02 Unutilised ITC
Zero-rated supplies / inverted duty: accumulated input credit.
Remember: Recover purchase credit, not excess output tax.
03 Refund voucher
Advance returned when supply does not take place.
Remember: Customer already got the tax back.
04 Wrong classification of supply
CGST + SGST paid instead of IGST, or vice versa.
Remember: Correct tax head; avoid paying twice.
05 Excess electronic cash ledger balance
Unused deposit, including eligible CTP / NRTP balances.
Remember: Own money; deposit is not tax payment.
06 Refund claimed by URP
Example: flat booking cancelled after GST credit-note deadline.
Builder returns base amount; URP claims eligible tax borne.
Remember: Actual bearer of tax; no passing on of burden.
EXAM TRAP
URP: exemption applies where applicant bears the tax incidence.
Refund eligibility and supporting documents still apply.
Section 54(8) / Rule 89(2) • Verify applicable ICAI exam cut-off.
